skill.name: executing-plans
skill.description: Executes a written implementation plan in verified batches with review checkpoints, feedback pauses, and explicit blocker handling.
skill.summary: Execute implementation plans in verified batches with human review checkpoints.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The single SKILL.md file contains only procedural guidance for reviewing and executing written implementation plans. No suspicious static patterns, prompt injection attempts, or intent-level security risks were found.

content.user_title: Execute Implementation Plans with Review Checkpoints
content.value_statement: Long implementation plans can drift when tasks are executed without review or verification. This skill delivers work in controlled batches with feedback checkpoints.
actual_capabilities: Reviews a written implementation plan and identifies concerns before work begins.
Uses three tasks as the default first execution batch.
Tracks each task from in progress through completion.
Runs verification steps specified by the implementation plan.
Reports completed work and verification results after each batch.
Stops for feedback, unclear instructions, blockers, or repeated verification failures.
limitations: Requires a written implementation plan with clear, actionable tasks.
Does not replace environment-specific testing, validation, or expert review.
References workflow tools and a finishing skill that may be unavailable in some environments.
Does not resolve missing dependencies, permissions, or ambiguous requirements without user input.

use_cases.title: Deliver a Planned Feature
use_cases.description: Execute a prepared feature plan in small batches and verify each completed task.

use_cases.title: Review Team Implementation Progress
use_cases.description: Receive concise checkpoint reports before approving the next group of planned changes.

use_cases.title: Control an AI Coding Session
use_cases.description: Keep automated implementation aligned with a reviewed plan and require pauses when blockers appear.

prompt_templates.title: Execute the First Batch
prompt_templates.prompt: Execute this plan: [plan path or text]. Review it first, identify blockers, then complete the first three tasks and report verification results.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start a planned implementation with the default batch size.

prompt_templates.title: Continue After Feedback
prompt_templates.prompt: Continue the reviewed implementation plan. Apply this feedback: [feedback]. Execute the next three pending tasks, run specified checks, and report results.
prompt_templates.scenario: Resume execution after a reviewer approves or adjusts the work.

prompt_templates.title: Use a Custom Batch
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [plan]. Assess dependencies and risks before editing. Execute [batch size] tasks after resolving concerns. Include changed files and verification evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Adjust checkpoint frequency for a larger or more sensitive plan.

prompt_templates.title: Manage Multi-Batch Delivery
prompt_templates.prompt: Execute [plan] across checkpoints. Summarize completed work, failed checks, plan deviations, and required decisions at each checkpoint. Stop on unresolved blockers.
prompt_templates.scenario: Coordinate an advanced implementation that requires several review cycles.

output_examples.input: Execute the first batch from docs/implementation-plan.md.
output: Completed tasks 1 through 3 and updated their status.

output_examples.input: Start the plan even if required configuration is missing.
output: Plan review found a blocking issue: the required configuration is not available.
Please provide the missing configuration or revise the affected task.

output_examples.input: Apply the review feedback and continue with the next batch.
output: Applied the requested adjustments to the completed batch.
Executed the next three pending tasks.
Verification completed successfully, with no unresolved deviations.

best_practices: Provide a plan with small tasks, dependencies, expected outcomes, and verification steps.
Resolve plan concerns before allowing implementation changes.
Review each checkpoint report before authorizing the next batch.
anti_patterns: Starting implementation without first reviewing the plan for gaps or conflicts.
Marking tasks complete before running their specified verification steps.
Continuing after an unresolved blocker or repeated verification failure.

faq.question: What input does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires a written implementation plan with clear tasks and expected verification steps.

faq.question: How many tasks are executed per batch?
faq.answer: The default first batch contains three tasks. A prompt can request a different batch size.

faq.question: Does it execute the entire plan at once?
faq.answer: No. It reports after each batch and waits for feedback before continuing.

faq.question: What happens when execution reaches a blocker?
faq.answer: Execution stops immediately, and the skill asks for clarification or the missing requirement.

faq.question: Does this skill replace testing?
faq.answer: No. It runs plan-specified checks but still requires environment-specific validation and expert review.

faq.question: How does the workflow finish development?
faq.answer: It references a separate finishing-development skill for final verification and branch completion. That skill must be available in the environment.
